target.title: feat(ios): implement branded design system in SwiftUI
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The iOS app uses system fonts (SF Pro) and has no shared typography, spacing, or component tokens. After #98930 landed the brand color palette, the remaining design-system gaps are custom fonts, typed scales, spacing/radius/motion tokens, and shared components (badge, toggle, button tiers).

## Why This Change Was Made

This is the continuation of the iOS design system after #98930 (color palette). It bundles Plus Jakarta Sans / DM Sans / JetBrains Mono fonts, adds `OpenClawType` typography tokens with Dynamic Type, `OpenClawSpacing` / `OpenClawRadius` tokens, shared `OpenClawStatusBadge` / `OpenClawToggleIndicator` components, new palette tokens (teal, void, obsidian, slate, text tiers), and migrates ~30 views to the new system. All existing accent/semantic RGB values from #98930 are preserved.

## User Impact

- All text across onboarding, settings, chat, talk, and gateway uses branded Plus Jakarta Sans / DM Sans instead of system SF Pro
- Chat gateway status shows a "Connected" pill badge instead of a small checkmark icon
- Privacy permission rows show `OpenClawStatusBadge` instead of raw colored text
- No accent/semantic color value changes (all RGB values from #98930 preserved)
- No workflow or feature behavior changes

## Evidence

### Screenshot methodology

Both builds used the full clean pipeline: `git checkout <ref>` → `pnpm ios:gen` (regenerate Xcode project from that ref's `project.yml`) → delete DerivedData → `xcodebuild build` → install on simulator → launch with `--openclaw-screenshot-mode`.

**Before:** `upstream/main` @ `c032f9809d` (post-#98930). Verified: `Sources/Fonts/` does not exist; 0 custom font files in app bundle; `Info.plist` has no `UIAppFonts`.

**After:** `feat/ios-design-system` @ `955f036e80`. Verified: 14 bundled font files; `UIAppFonts` lists all 14. All accent/semantic RGB values identical to `main`.

### Chat — Connected badge + typography (light mode)

**What changed:** Gateway status switches from a green checkmark icon to an `OpenClawStatusBadge` "Connected" pill with green dot. "Molty" header and body text switch from SF Pro to Plus Jakarta Sans.

| Before (`main`) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|
| ![chat before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before-light/chat-light.png?v=5) | ![chat after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after-light/chat-light.png?v=5) |

### Settings — typography (light mode)

**What changed:** "Settings" heading, "Gateway", "Approvals", "Permissions", "Channels", "Voice & Talk" labels, "Device" section header, and subtitles all switch from SF Pro to Plus Jakarta Sans via `OpenClawType` tokens.

| Before (`main`) | After (this PR) |
|---|---|
| ![settings before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/before-light/settings-light.png?v=5) | ![settings after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joelnishanth/openclaw/pr-assets/ios-design-system/.github/pr-assets/ios-design-system/after-light/settings-light.png?v=5) |

### Validation

```bash
# Verify main has no bundled fonts, branch does:
git checkout upstream/main && pnpm ios:gen
cd apps/ios && xcodebuild build
ls Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/OpenClaw.app/PlusJakartaSans*.ttf  # expect: none

git checkout feat/ios-design-system && rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/OpenClaw-*
pnpm ios:gen && cd apps/ios && xcodebuild build
ls Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/OpenClaw.app/PlusJakartaSans*.ttf  # expect: 6 files
```

- iOS simulator build: **BUILD SUCCEEDED**
- `OpenClawTypographyTests`: **2/2 passed**

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

- Behavior or issue addressed: Branded typography, spacing tokens, and shared components (continuation of #98930 color palette)
- Real environment tested: macOS, Xcode iOS Simulator (iPhone 17 Pro), Debug build; before from `upstream/main` @ `c032f9809d`, after from this branch @ `955f036e80`
- Exact steps or command run after this patch: for each ref: `git checkout <ref>`, `pnpm ios:gen`, `rm -rf DerivedData`, `xcodebuild build`, `simctl install`, launch with `--openclaw-screenshot-mode --openclaw-appearance light --openclaw-initial-tab <tab>`, `simctl io screenshot`; plus `OpenClawTypographyTests`
- Evidence after fix: before/after light-mode PNGs above (assets branch `pr-assets/ios-design-system`)
- Observed result after fix: custom fonts in after build only; chat header shows Connected badge instead of checkmark; all tabs use Plus Jakarta Sans; accent RGB unchanged
- What was not tested: physical device walkthrough, iPad layouts, dark mode visual comparison
- Proof limitations: screenshot fixture mode, not live gateway pairing

— [Joel Nishanth](https://offlyn.ai) · [offlyn.AI](https://offlyn.ai)
